data.text:
[7:20AM] #LagBagagryExpWay
#TrafficUpdate

Very busy movement from Custom check point down to Ajibade/Odofa due to contraflow and ongoing road construction along the corridor. 

Movement is free from Odofa enroute Ibiye, Magbon , Okoafo, Elijah all the way to Badagry roundabout. 

Movement around Badagry roundabout is very good at the moment. 

The return journey from the Roundabout back to Odofa is appreciable as well.
